facts.statement: The base gun holds three shots.
facts.method: Cross-checked the moveset description and three-dot ammunition HUD before card modifiers.

facts.statement: A base bullet removes about 55 percent of base health, making two clean hits lethal.
facts.method: Used the community approximately-60-percent value and repeated two-hit kills in footage.

facts.statement: The unmodified gun has roughly an 18-tick minimum interval between shots.
facts.method: Provisional implementation hypothesis constrained by visible muzzle events; the selected footage does not isolate a minimum-rate sequence with a fully controlled loadout.

facts.statement: An empty unmodified magazine refills after about 120 ticks.
facts.method: Provisional implementation hypothesis constrained by ammunition-HUD cycles; the selected footage does not isolate an empty-magazine cycle with a fully controlled reload loadout.

facts.statement: Reload begins automatically after the last shot and completes the whole magazine together.
facts.method: Tracked ammunition dots after magazine depletion in both recordings.

facts.statement: The two retained fixed projectile tracks support an unmodified bullet speed of about 0.38 player diameters per tick.
facts.method: Computed camera-compensated Euclidean core displacement for retained footage-ssag frames 838..844 and 972..981, divided by the same-scene 18-pixel player diameter, elapsed spans 6 and 9, and two simulation ticks per 30-fps source frame, then rounded the mean of 0.3928371 and 0.3675076 to two decimals.

facts.statement: The base damaging projectile radius is about eight percent of a player diameter, smaller than its streak and glow.
facts.method: Separated the bright core from the larger motion streak in close frames.

facts.statement: Base bullets are destroyed on their first environment impact.
facts.method: Compared base projectiles with later explicit bounce-card behavior.

facts.statement: Each base shot gives the shooter roughly 0.10 player diameters per tick of opposite velocity.
facts.method: Measured immediate shooter velocity changes after early-match shots whose visible starting cards do not alter recoil.

facts.statement: A base bullet imparts knockback along its travel direction in addition to damage.
facts.method: Observed target acceleration after nonlethal hits from several directions.

facts.statement: Base block protects for about 12 ticks.
facts.method: Counted the visible circular shield from appearance through collapse at 30 fps in two early-match samples whose visible cards do not alter block duration.

facts.statement: Base block recharges in about 240 ticks.
facts.method: Provisional implementation hypothesis constrained by block availability and card wording; the selected footage does not isolate two cooldown-limited inputs with a fully controlled loadout.

facts.statement: A projectile contacting an active block is reflected away and does not deal its direct hit damage.

tolerance.value: reflected projectile can threaten its former owner

facts.method: Tracked shield contacts and reflected bullet paths in both recordings.

facts.statement: Block does not erase damage-over-time effects that were already applied.
facts.method: Used the moveset description and poison-card sequences.

facts.statement: Block applies a radial impulse to nearby players and can launch the blocker when used next to the arena boundary.
facts.method: Cross-checked close-range blocks and wall-adjacent shield bounces.

facts.statement: A player dies when health reaches zero or when the body leaves the arena kill bounds.
facts.method: Observed both projectile deaths and fall or launch deaths.
